name: Holy Nova
description: Cast a nova of holy light dealing arcane damage to monsters and healing all allies hit.

zh.name: 神圣新星
zh.description: 施放一阵神圣之光新星，对怪物造成奥术伤害，并治疗所有被击中的盟友。

subskills.name: Holy Nova
subskills.description: Core of the Holy Nova subtree.

zh.name: 神圣新星
zh.description: 神圣新星 子树核心。

subskills.name: Crusade Allies
subskills.description: Allies healed by holy nova take reduced damage for a short period.

zh.name: Crusade Allies
zh.description: Allies 被治疗神圣新星承受降低伤害短距期间。

subskills.name: Practical Punishment
subskills.description: Chance to stun monsters on hit.

zh.name: Practical Punishment
zh.description: 命中时有概率眩晕怪物。

subskills.name: Strength Prayer
subskills.description: Increases area of effect radius of holy nova.

zh.name: 力量祈祷
zh.description: 提高 effect radius of 神圣新星 的范围。

subskills.name: Strong Faith
subskills.description: Increases the damage dealt by holy nova.

zh.name: Strong Faith
zh.description: 提高造成的伤害神圣新星。

subskills.name: Spiritual Awakening
subskills.description: Holy nova no longer heals you or your allies but recovers a portion of your maximum mana instead.

zh.name: 灵性 Awakening
zh.description: 神圣新星更久治疗你你的 allies 恢复一部分你的最大法力改为。

subskills.name: Restore Light
subskills.description: Holy nova heals you for a portion of your missing life.

zh.name: Restore 光明
zh.description: 神圣新星治疗你一部分你的 missing 生命。

subskills.name: Blessing Buff
subskills.description: Chance on cast to increase your and allied arcane damage and magic find for a short period.

zh.name: Blessing 增益
zh.description: 施法时有概率提高你的与 allied 奥术伤害与魔法发现短距期间。

subskills.name: Warrior's Light
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by holy nova scaling with your vitality.

zh.name: 战士的光明
zh.description: 提高 神圣新星 scaling with your vitality 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Deliver Consequences
subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by holy nova and gives a chance to instantly execute non-boss targets affected by mark of judgement.

zh.name: Deliver Consequences
zh.description: 提高 神圣新星 and gives a chance to instantly 处决 non-boss targets affected by mark of judgement 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Heaven's Chosen
subskills.description: Chance on cast to unleash an additional holy nova.

zh.name: Heaven's Chosen
zh.description: 施法时有概率释放额外神圣新星。

subskills.name: Righteous Transaction
subskills.description: Steal a portion of target life on hit over time.

zh.name: Righteous Transaction
zh.description: 偷取一部分目标生命命中时随时间。

subskills.name: Mark of Judgement
subskills.description: Mark target monsters with judgement on hit causing them to take increased damage on hit consuming the mark.

zh.name: 印记之 Judgement
zh.description: 印记目标怪物使用 judgement 命中时使其承受提高伤害命中时消耗印记。

subskills.name: Remote Prayer
subskills.description: Holy nova now heals all allies within the same area with increased power.

zh.name: Remote 祈祷
zh.description: 神圣新星治疗全部 allies 之内相同范围使用提高力量。

subskills.name: Faith's Winds
subskills.description: Unleash multiple smaller orbiting novas around you.

zh.name: Faith's 狂风
zh.description: 释放多个更小环绕新星周围你。

name: Holy Hammer
description: Summon a holy hammer that spirals outwards dealing arcane damage on hit.

zh.name: 神圣战锤
zh.description: 召唤一把螺旋向外飞旋的神圣战锤，命中时造成奥术伤害。

subskills.name: Holy Hammer
subskills.description: Core of the Holy Hammer subtree.

zh.name: 神圣战锤
zh.description: 神圣战锤 子树核心。

subskills.description: Increases holy hammer projectile speed.

zh.description: 提高神圣战锤投射物速度。

subskills.description: Increases damage dealt by holy hammer.

zh.name: 祝福光明
zh.description: 提高 神圣战锤 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Divine Prayer
subskills.description: Decreases holy hammer mana cost.

zh.name: 神圣祈祷
zh.description: 降低神圣战锤法力消耗。

subskills.name: Free of Sin
subskills.description: Decreases movement diminish when using holy hammer.

zh.name: Free 之 Sin
zh.description: 使用神圣战锤时降低移动衰减。

subskills.name: Smite

zh.name: Smite
zh.description: 命中时有概率ricochet 额外 hammer 进入最近的怪物。

subskills.name: Double Forge
subskills.description: Chance on cast to unleash an additional hammer.

zh.name: 双重 Forge
zh.description: 施法时有概率释放额外 hammer。

subskills.name: Thor’s Revenge
subskills.description: Chance on hit to drop a hammer down from the sky dealing area of effect damage.

zh.name: Thor's Revenge
zh.description: 命中时有概率投下 hammer 倒地从天空造成范围伤害。

subskills.name: Sacred Hammer
subskills.description: Inflicts arcane break on hit.

zh.name: Sacred Hammer
zh.description: 命中时施加奥术击破。

subskills.name: Colossus Hammer
subskills.description: Increases the size of holy hammers.

zh.name: 巨像 Hammer
zh.description: 提高 holy hammers 的size。

subskills.name: Slamming Mallet
subskills.description: Hammers now knock monsters back unleashing a holy pulse on hit dealing area of effect damage.

zh.name: 猛击 Mallet
zh.description: 锤击击退怪物释放神圣脉冲命中时造成范围伤害。

subskills.name: Divine Lightning
subskills.description: Hammers unleash a chain of divine lightning on hit.

zh.name: 神圣闪电
zh.description: 锤击释放连锁之神圣闪电命中时。

subskills.name: Returning Lightforge
subskills.description: Throw multiple hammers traveling in a straight line and returning to you. Hammers no longer orbit.

zh.name: 返回 Lightforge
zh.description: 投掷多个锤击飞行 straight line 与返回至你。锤击更久轨道。

subskills.name: Orbital Light
subskills.description: Hammers now follow you with increased radius and damage.

zh.name: 环绕光明
zh.description: 锤击跟随你使用提高半径与伤害。

subskills.name: Chaining Mallet
subskills.description: Throw hammers that chain on hit dealing area of effect damage.

zh.name: 连锁 Mallet
zh.description: 投掷锤击连锁命中时造成范围伤害。

name: Holy Aura
description: When active, increases your and your party members attack damage and magic skill damage.

zh.name: 神圣光环
zh.description: 激活时，提高你和队友的攻击伤害和魔法技能伤害。

name: Fist of the Heavens
description: Call down a fist of divine energy exploding into multiple Holy Bolts dealing arcane damage.

zh.description: 从天而降召唤神圣能量之拳，爆裂成多支神圣之箭，造成奥术伤害。

subskills.name: Fist of the Heavens
subskills.description: Core of the Fist of the Heavens subtree.

zh.name: 天堂之拳
zh.description: 天堂之拳 子树核心。

subskills.name: One with the Faith
subskills.description: Increases the amount of projectiles.

zh.description: 提高 projectiles 的数量。

zh.name: 守卫 Angels
zh.description: 提高 天堂之拳 造成的伤害。

subskills.name: Punish the Sinners
subskills.description: Chance to inflict arcane break on hit.

zh.name: Punish Sinners
zh.description: 命中时有概率施加奥术击破。

zh.name: Trust Faith

subskills.name: Heaven's Wrath
subskills.description: Holy bolts now return back to the point of impact dealing increased damage.

zh.name: Heaven's 愤怒
zh.description: 神圣电矢反伤回至点之冲击造成提高伤害。

subskills.name: Heaven's Might
subskills.description: Chance to stun target on hit.

zh.name: Heaven's Might
zh.description: 命中时有概率眩晕目标。

subskills.name: Divine Reach
subskills.description: Increases cast rate when using fist of the heavens.

zh.name: 神圣延伸

subskills.name: Crusader of Heavens
subskills.description: Chance on cast to summon an additional fist.

subskills.name: Halting Luminosity

subskills.description: Fist of the heavens no longer fires holy bolts. Instead unleash a holy nova scaling its damage based on projectile amount.

subskills.name: Immaculate Warrior

zh.description: 猛击使用重拳造成提高伤害基于投射物数量施加奥术击破与击退回目标。

subskills.name: Tiring Combat
subskills.description: Summon multiple smaller fist of the heavens orbiting you and unleashing holy bolts on hit.

zh.description: 召唤物多个更小天堂之拳环绕你与释放神圣电矢命中时。

name: The Venerated One
description: Temporarily increases your cast rate and mana replenish.

zh.name: 受尊崇者
zh.description: 临时提高你的施法速度和法力恢复。
